denial_info.denial_reason_text: Out-of-network psychotherapy denied — plan has no out-of-network behavioral health benefit.

evidence.fact: Patient documented a network-adequacy problem: no in-network therapist available within access standards.
evidence.quote_from_note: no in-network therapist within 40 miles had a new-patient opening before June; she contacted four listed providers

evidence.fact: Objective improvement on standardized measure — treatment is effective and ongoing need remains.
evidence.quote_from_note: GAD-7 score improved from 15 (severe) at intake in January to 9 (moderate) today.
Good progress on measurable goals but not yet at treatment completion.

reasons: Model's base assessment: 42/100 — out-of-network exclusions are hard, but parity/network-adequacy arguments exist.
+20 — two or more supporting quotes found in the chart.
Payer's own policy BH-N1 allows a network-adequacy override; the note documents 4 failed in-network attempts.
